the first meeting in Little Italy

edition.tagline: Some lessons aren't taught at film school.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when the Gourmet Club menu gets read out.

s.note: Carmine's social club, where the job offer comes with a handshake
s.how: Arrange 100g salami, 100g mortadella and 150g provolone on a board. Add 2 roasted red capsicums cut into strips and 200g marinated artichokes. Tear a loaf of seeded Italian bread at the table.
Slice 500g squid tubes into rings, soak in 200ml milk for 20 minutes and toss in 120g flour mixed with 2 tbsp semolina and salt. Fry at 190C for 1 minute and serve with lemon and 250g marinara.

m.note: the family dinner where Clark gets told how things work
m.how: Dust 600g veal escalopes with seasoned flour and sear in 20g butter and a little oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside. Brown 250g sliced button mushrooms in the pan, add 150ml marsala and 150ml beef stock and reduce by half. Whisk in 40g cold butter, return the veal and warm through.

w.note: a box from Little Italy for the drive back to campus
w.how: Drain 500g fresh ricotta for 2 hours, then beat with 80g icing sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract and 50g mini choc chips. Pipe into 8 cannoli shells just before serving and dip the ends in 30g chopped pistachios.

d.how: Open one 750ml bottle of Chianti Classico half an hour ahead and keep it at about 16C. Pour into four tumblers, about 180ml each, and keep the bottle on the table for refills during the dinner.
